Definition: A skill that produces an immutable estimate snapshot under the estimating tool root for a bounded scope.
A required enum whose values are QUOTE, RATE_TABLE, HISTORICAL, PARAMETRIC, or ALLOWANCE.
A BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value for vendor-quoted prices from explicit quote lines in vendor documents.
A BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value for labor, material, or equipment rates from published tables.
A BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value for prior cost data with normalization.
A BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value for an approved parametric model with formulas and parameters.
A BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE value for allowance tables or budgets.
A required field whose value is the top-level execution root.
A required field restricted to the execution root _Estimates directory.
A required scope selector for deliverable IDs, package IDs, or a path glob.
A required currency code or project-defined currency token.
A required existing estimating tool root directory.
A decomposition markdown path that may be provided or auto-located under _Decomposition.
Dependency evidence sources that default to AUTO or may be explicit paths.
Local basis evidence files or folders and the only authoritative pricing inputs.
A short, stable identifier used in snapshot naming.
An optional flag controlling whether _LATEST.md is updated.
An optional policy that defaults to STRICT and controls allowed fallback methods.
An optional flag that controls whether Detail.csv may mix methods.
The generic TASK shell mode used without a profile.
The estimate line-item CSV with canonical pricing, method, provenance, and confidence columns.
A required rollup matrix with totals by WBS package, deliverable, CBS, and currency.
A required snapshot artifact containing run configuration, scope, sources, policies, rounding, and warnings.
A required snapshot artifact that reports QA checks, coverage, provenance completeness, blockers, and RUN_STATUS.
A required snapshot artifact indexing each PRICE_SOURCES entry and its support boundaries.
A required snapshot artifact recording defaults applied, fallback uses, and scope-resolution decisions.
A required snapshot artifact recording explicit assumptions with IDs.
A blocker artifact listing unresolved inputs by deliverable with evidence references.
A provenance reference required on every priced row unless the row explicitly states location TBD.
A Detail.csv field whose values are LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH and must match method rules.
Confidence for human-confirmed values and vendor-quoted values.
Confidence for stable published rate-table derivations, normalized historical data, and approved parametric model outputs.
Confidence for allowance-table values, sparse historical analogs, and weakly grounded parametric outputs.
The rule that estimate-snapshot writes only under ESTIMATES_ROOT and does not modify project truth files.
The rule that every run writes a new snapshot folder and never overwrites an existing one.
The rule that unsubstantiated values are recorded as TBD and surfaced in QA instead of guessed.
The QA check comparing Detail.csv Method values to BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE unless permitted deviations are logged.
A QA percentage reporting how many priced rows have non-TBD provenance.
A dependency-row hint that may be passed through only when present and must not be invented.
The prohibited use of prior _Estimates snapshots as pricing sources unless explicitly included in PRICE_SOURCES.
